ideas.idea: Add the missing reception.jpg image file and an Eleventy passthrough copy for /img
ideas.why: No img folder exists and .eleventy.js copies only robots.txt and sitemap.xml, so the homepage image likely 404s.

ideas.idea: Back up the 'Trusted by thousands' claim with a real figure, review count or years in practice
ideas.why: The homepage makes an unsupported claim at index.njk:7, and a concrete figure helps readers and machines trust it.

ideas.idea: Show real prices or starting prices on the services page
ideas.why: services.njk says 'Our prices are simple and clear' but lists no prices.

ideas.idea: Name the dentists with qualifications and registration numbers, and add Dentist or Person structured data
ideas.why: team.njk is vague and has no names, so adding them gives people and machines real entities to understand.

ideas.idea: Give each service its own page, such as /services/implants/
ideas.why: services.njk is a bare four-item list, and separate pages could each be found and linked on their own.

ideas.idea: Complete the Dentist JSON-LD with address, url, openingHours and image
ideas.why: The JSON-LD has only name and telephone, while the page shows an address that the markup omits.

ideas.idea: Add opening hours and emergency contact details
ideas.why: The homepage promises emergency appointments, but contact.njk gives no hours or emergency number.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph tags (og:title, og:description, og:image) to the layout
ideas.why: base.njk has none, but this is standard advice for any site and has little effect on search or AI discovery.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod dates to the sitemap
ideas.why: This is accurate but applies to almost any site and has modest effect on a four-URL sitemap.

ideas.idea: Link onward to booking or contact from the services and team pages
ideas.why: This is accurate, but the nav already links to Contact, so the effect is small.
